paragraphs.text:
After a hard day’s trek, alert for the dangers and oddities of the 
valley, you and Norman withdraw for the night under a granite 
overhang and light a fire of twigs and pine needles.

Make a Science (Geology) roll: if you succeed, go to 596; if you fail, 
go to 513.
